I don't remember which one, or what happened exactly.\nperson_1 (DOCTOR) 171.99-172.95s: Any smoking?\nperson_2 (PATIENT) 174.34-178.30s: I smoke about ten cigarettes a day\nperson_1 (DOCTOR) 181.16-183.15s: And alcohol, how much?\nperson_2 (PATIENT) 184.16-186.74s: I don't drink at all.\nperson_1 (DOCTOR) 188.07-189.51s: how about exercise?\nperson_2 (PATIENT) 191.38-195.52s: Not really, I don't get much exercise.\nperson_1 (DOCTOR) 196.23-197.92s: Do you live alone?\nperson_2 (PATIENT) 201.33-205.07s: Yes, I live on my own.\nperson_1 (DOCTOR) 209.04-212.27s: have you noticed bleeding, vomiting or neck stiffness?\nperson_2 (PATIENT) 213.01-216.25s: No, none of that at all.\nperson_1 (DOCTOR) 217.73-219.73s: have you had any diarrhoea?\nperson_2 (PATIENT) 221.62-223.55s: No, no diarrhoea.\nperson_3 (CAREGIVER) 225.05-230.66s: actually, doctor, I did notice diarrhoea he doesn't always say\nperson_2 (PATIENT) 232.29-241.03s: I mean, no, I don't think I did. Maybe a little, I'm not sure.\nperson_1 (DOCTOR) 246.16-253.60s: alright, I'll note both what you've said and what you've noticed.
